meaning.en: To remove (soap, for example) by washing lightly in water.

sentences.en: Some mouthwashes, toothpastes and rinses contain tea tree oil, but several studies show more harm than good from these products, so it may be best to avoid them for the time being.

sentences.en: Using a proprietary technology, these guards siphon water that rinses debris from the guards.

sentences.en: Plus size Seven jeans are available in a variety of cuts, rinses and styles, and all are made with a bit of stretch for the ultimate level of comfort.

sentences.en: Choices for pain relief include medication, ointments, or mouth rinses recommended by the pediatrician.
